problem: A saved research preflight stopped before review-1. A native host source amendment advanced candidate-1 to candidate-2. After independent review-2 reports needs-revision, admission incorrectly requires nonexistent review-1 instead of proving the saved native source-research transition.
requirements: Keep real negative reviews, current source/extraction pins, independently assembled report coverage, original-to-current replay, repair author independence, ownership, circuit breaker and maximum three rounds.
Never synthesize a skipped review, reset a circuit, edit sealed source evidence, or treat a preflight amendment as date approval.

Recover missing review only with content-addressed deterministic unresolved preflight, no started review ownership/artifacts, actual native amendment with recorded author, exact next candidate facts and complete original-to-current replay.
